newsitem.title: USA: Grove Real Estate sets 5 pct stock div.
newsitem.headline: Grove Real Estate sets 5 pct stock div.

text.p: Grove Real Estate Trust said Friday it had declared a five percent stock dividend payable March 28.

The company also said it will undergo a series of transactions culminating in the consolidation of properties into a new, larger real estate investment trust to be called Grove Property Trust, which will take the place of Grove Real Estate Trust.
It said the transactions will close March 11 or 12. The stock dividend will be paid to holders of record as of the day before the closing of the transactions.
Separately, the company said, it is extending the exchange offer for its limited partners to March 7 from February 15.
